# DJ Zwackery

> Hardcore DJ from Melbourne, Australia, playing Happy Hardcore, UK Hardcore, and hard dance at 150+ BPM under the banner "House of Fun." Streams live on Twitch (Twitch Partner) and posts a new set to YouTube most weeks.

DJ Zwackery is djzwackery.com's single-page site: bio, live status, upcoming gigs, a set archive, and a booking contact form all live on the one page, linked below by section. The live badge and embedded Twitch player update automatically, with no page reload, whenever he goes live.

## Sections

- [About](https://djzwackery.com/#about): bio, genre, location, Twitch Partner status
- [Gigs](https://djzwackery.com/#gigs): upcoming live shows with ticket links, auto-hides past dates
- [Latest sets](https://djzwackery.com/#videos): YouTube set archive embedded on-site

## Key facts

- Genres: Hardcore, Happy Hardcore, UK Hardcore, hard dance, techno
- Tempo: 150+ BPM
- Based in: Melbourne, Australia
- Twitch status: Partner

- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@DJZwackery1): set archive

- Bookings: djzwackery@hotmail.com, or the contact form at the bottom of the homepage

## Notes

- The site is also available in Japanese (/ja/), German (/de/), Dutch (/nl/), French (/fr/), and Italian (/it/); English is the default at the root path.
- Structured data (schema.org MusicGroup, Event, VideoObject) is present in the page's JSON-LD for machine-readable bio, gig, and video details.
